title: Uniqueness of unary rest length
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean word and let $n,n'\in\mathbb{N}$. If, for each of $n$ and $n'$, every pair of positions $2i,2i+1$ with $0\le i$ strictly below that number contains true, while the pair at positions $2n,2n+1$ (respectively $2n',2n'+1$) contains false followed by true, then $n=n'$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ satisfies the unary rest condition with length $n$
$x$ satisfies the unary rest condition with length $n'$
